*updates post-announcement*

Hi guys, I've played this quite a bit. I decided to read through the negative reviews and there is just a LOT of misinformation in there.

I'll set some things straight!

1. The underwear that is $9.99 does not have ANY stats on it. Everyone spreading information that it does has no idea what they are talking about.

2. The DLC classes are not overpowered. The meta is Archer/Witch, Archer/Fist, Archer/Sword, or Fist/Sword. If anything, Archer may be a tad bit strong :3.

3. Some people said that their ult did less damage than an auto attack. They were likely comparing archer ult (not very high damage) to witch auto attack (witch does a lot of damage, but easy to dodge as the projectiles are slow with plenty of space between).

4. This was marketed as a PvE/PvP game. It was my understanding that the focus would be on PvP. There really isn't much content here, but this shouldn't stop you from having a bit of fun every now and then while you wait for them to add new content. They already mentioned, a few days in, adding the dual blade class soon.

5. People have mentioned grinding to unlock gear that has better stats than the starter gear. All gear shares the same strength. The stat types may vary, but the stat values start at the same regardless of the type of gear. You grind to unlock gear for cosmetic purpose or increase the strength of existing gear through an upgrade system.

6. Stunlock PvP? You can definitely get stunlocked. That's why it's 2v2 and you can swap between a breaker and a slayer. The breaker can easily break stunlocks + tank. All about that teamwork. If you charge in alone and get 1v2'd, you're probably going to get stunlocked 100-0. This is a pure "git gud" right here.

7. Lag, lobby bug, steam inventory item usage... well, this is an Early Access game, so... they're already releasing an emergency patch a few days in. Still plenty of bugs, but they were addressed by the announcement. We can assume that they are working to resolve these issues.

8. DLC for $$. They are removing this. These classes will now be free.

9. The lootboxes, I will not lie, are garbo.

10. Rebirth tokens are a clear P2W, but they are already resolving them.


What you will get is a fantastic combat system, great graphics, and fun 2v2 matches ^_^. I'd recommend to start getting serious at launch when they have a whole bunch of content for you to enjoy and to just touch on it until then = ). PvE can get really repetitive, but I personally find the PvP to be loads of fun even if the modes are kinda uninspiring and the stages are few.

An MMORPG PvE game based at it's core...however.

Doing dungeons are one of the main sources for getting gold and gear. Gear however is on a certain %. Recently their update has a new class. with that came new items and the % from dungeons has been reduced. Before the update the chances was 1/2/5% from a certain levels of that specific dungeon. Now they're halved in %, making them twice as hard.  Losing doesnt reward you with anything as well, though you will be assigned with someone else during dungeon/raids.

PVP:
For a PvE game at it's core, the game is more rewarding through PvP. This isnt the most friendly way to obtain items/gold as the chances to be to be in an entire CC CHAIN is high. As a result from most likely vsing people with a high playtime and skill level than you. They do have a feature now to break out of the CC Chain, however it ends up being a 50-50 to be locked into another chain, only this time your break out of chain cc is on a cooldown.

Cosmetics, high price ofc. The game is still fairly new, it's their main source of keeping the game alive. 

Are the DLCs worth buying? 
A: They provide you with a new class, new weapons and a short campaign. For the price it's worth, it really depends on your currency. (For me looking back at it, it wasnt worth it. It costed $15 for me)

This game.. what a doozy this review will be to write.

So first off, THIS GAME IS IN NO WAY, SHAPE, OR FORM PAY TO WIN. The classes ARE COMING OUT FOR FREE.
They've addressed this in the stream, and on the news page. For gods sake people, READ! 

Onto the gameplay:
It's a mission-based game. You queue for missions, complete the missions, get rewards and come back. That's basically the entire game as of right now. PVP works essentially the same way.

It is possible to play this game entirely PvE, and not see a single bit of PvP. There ARE mission cooldowns at times with PvE.

I find the game quite fun, despite not having many hours. I [b]DID[/b] buy the Karma DLCs but ONLY because I wanted to get the outfit and weapons that come with once they go free. 

Onto the community.
The community is all over the place.
You've got people who complain about other people taking their outfit ideas. (duh, take it as a compliment, they think it looks good) 
You've got people who scream pay to win, touching on supply boxes. (the difference in stats is negligible, if not non-existent.) I have outfits that have the exact same stats even though some are from the supply boxes) Also, note the fact that the supply boxes will be made AP/CP purchasable only! (that's the ingame currency. That you can't buy.)

Overall... 7/10, would watch my teats jiggle again.

Everything needs to be reworked.

The entire base foundation of the game needs to be changed. The NPCs in spawn need to be removed, the option to hide all players in spawn needs to be added, the chests that let you buy dumb crap need to be removed, the alpha spawn needs to replace the new one, the enchantment table has to go back up in the library, the other 2 useless items need to be reworked, the dungeons should have some sort of effort put into them (enemies that ACTUALLY attack, puzzles, idk look at whatever genshin is doing), grinding for exp shouldn't be so redundant, pvp matching has to be fixed (C ranks shouldn't be matched with G), the trade table has to become the mission menu again, and the trades have to be a separate section. A

Everything had a purpose in the alpha, and it all made sense. Now, a bunch of models are being used for other purposes, and their uses don't make any sense, at all. There's a bunch of pay to win bullshit, which has to be removed immediately, and the garbage cosmetics need to be fixed. The music has to be reverted to the old music, since the new songs are terrible (not even kidding, the old main lobby music was MUCH better), and the bosses have to be fixed. DP is way too hard to obtain, which really encourages people to dumb money in an early access game. Fixing the ranks was a good move imo, but rank M makes no sense. The ranks should go from E/D - G (not including M) and should go up to 4 subsections instead of 3. The game needs some optimization, and deranking should be put in for A rank and above (good).

The game should be pay to play. If you really want this to be a competitive pvp game that is GOOD, that is what you should do. This gives the game more value and makes the devs less inclined to put in a bunch of dlc, p2w bullshit everywhere, which COMPLETELY ruins the game's aesthetics and will most likely cause it to die even more than it already has.
